We regularly work with companies, associations, organisations and groups wishing to hire coaches in Tarragona for special events, congresses, excursions, national tourist trips and bus trips abroad.

about.title: Empresa Plana - About Us
about.heroTitle: More than 60 years evolving and adapting to the needs of our users.
about.qualityTitle: QUALITY, ENVIRONMENT, OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH & SAFETY AND ROAD SAFETY POLICY.
about.qualityIntro: EMPRESA PLANA, from its bases in Tarragona, Reus, Calafell and Vilanova i la Geltrú, offers public passenger road transport services, including regular urban and interurban lines, school, company and discretionary transport.
about.qualityBody: Our goal is to achieve the expected business results, providing our clients and stakeholders with safe services that satisfactorily meet their needs and expectations, carried out through environmentally respectful processes, always bearing in mind Occupational Health and Safety, as well as Road Safety, both today and in the future.
about.qualityCommitment: Therefore, the Management decides to establish a Management System in accordance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, UNE-EN 13816, ISO 45001 and ISO 39001 standards and declares its commitment to complying with the legislation and regulations applicable to Quality, the Environment, Occupational Health and Safety, Road Safety and Equality, and with the requirements arising from commitments signed by the organisation, with the following policy:
qualityBullets: Up-to-date knowledge and its transmission about how our processes and activities influence customer satisfaction, the environment, occupational health and safety, road safety, the corresponding legal requirements and the commitments signed by the organisation are the basis for management.

All quality deficiencies, harm to the environment, damage and deterioration of health at work, as well as road safety risks, within the company's scope of responsibility, can be prevented, controlled and minimised, and must be done so systematically, with documentation and continuous improvement criteria, both in normal and emergency situations.
The commitment to protecting the environment, including pollution prevention, and other specific commitments relevant to the organisation's context.

The commitment to providing safe and healthy working conditions to prevent work-related injuries and ill health, helping to eliminate hazards and reduce risks to Occupational Health and Safety, as well as the consultation and participation of workers.
Errors must be detected and solved as quickly as necessary, taking effective actions to prevent their repetition and improving prevention and emergency mechanisms.

Each employee, duly trained and motivated at all levels, must be aware of their personal responsibility and attentive to the impact of their activity on service quality, on the environment, on occupational health and safety risks, as well as on road safety, committing to know and apply what is established in the System documentation and actively participating, within an adequate organisational environment, in the continuous improvement of the system.

The permanent will to improve is shown through objectives and goals, and through the implementation of integrated or specific plans and programmes for Quality, Environment, Occupational Health and Safety, Road Safety and Equality.

The Management System is reviewed periodically and systematically, including policy, objectives and the provision of necessary resources, in order to achieve continuous improvement of its effectiveness.

cookiePolicy.definition: In accordance with the provisions of Law 34/2002 on Information Society Services and Electronic Commerce, we inform you that this website stores information on the IP addresses of computers and uses Cookies in order to provide a better service and offer you a better browsing experience.
cookiePolicy.definitionBody: Cookies are small text files containing information, generated on the User's computer or device when browsing the website. By browsing this website you give your consent to receive these Cookies.
cookiePolicy.typesTitle: What types of cookies do we use?
cookiePolicy.typesByTime: According to the length of time they remain active:
cookiePolicy.sessionCookies: Session cookies: A type of cookie designed to collect and store data while you access our website, remaining in your browser's cookie file until you leave the page. For example, identification cookies.
cookiePolicy.persistentCookies: Persistent cookies: A type of cookie in which the data remains stored on the device and can be accessed and processed for a certain period of time.
cookiePolicy.typesByPurpose: According to their purpose and the entity that manages them:
cookiePolicy.ownCookies: First-party cookies: Those sent to your computer or device from our website.
cookiePolicy.thirdPartyCookies: Third-party cookies: Those sent to your computer or device from a domain or website not managed by us, but by a collaborating entity.
cookiePolicy.technicalCookies: Technical cookies: those necessary for browsing and the proper functioning of our website. For example, they allow the purchase process, control the security aspects of the website and share content through social networks…
cookiePolicy.analyticsCookies: Analytics cookies: Those which, whether processed by us or by third parties, allow us to quantify the number of users and perform statistical measurement and analysis of how users use our website.
cookiePolicy.advertisingCookies: Advertising and behavioural advertising cookies: Advertising cookies allow the most efficient management of advertising spaces that may be included on our website, based on criteria such as the edited content or the frequency with which the ads are shown.
cookiePolicy.configureTitle: How can I configure or disable cookies?
cookiePolicy.configure: You can configure your browser to be notified of the receipt of cookies and refuse to accept them by activating the browser setting that allows rejecting them. However, we warn you that disabling Cookies may limit or even prevent access to some of the functionalities of our website, and some services may stop working correctly.
cookiePolicy.configureHelp: For more details on configuring cookies in your browser, consult its "Help" menu.
cookiePolicy.googleCookies: Google: Google offers a large number of products to help us manage our ads and websites, including Google Analytics. When visiting our website, some cookies may be sent to your browser.
